Name: ReplaceBombsKentMail
Author: LiziAnne
Description: Does exactly what it says on the tin: replaces the Bombs that Kent sends in the mail with some other shed related items, going off his mail text of "I found some things in the shed". This is my first mod, inspired by this github post [url=https://github.com/StardewModders/mod-ideas/issues/449]here[/url].

Manifest.Name: KentMail
Manifest.Description: Replaces the bombs Kent sends in the mail with other shed related items (5 grass starter, 10 basic fertiliser, 10 copper ore)
Manifest.Author: Lizi
